scientific_choices.rationale: External contours; 8-connected foreground-pixel area; original RGB pixel units; deterministic xyxy ties; exact-box deduplication only.

scientific_choices.rationale: Disable component-area rejection (minimum zero) and extra output padding (zero); retain ten seeds, ten children per seed and ten final proposals. Crop context uses fraction 0.5 plus four original RGB pixels per side.
scientific_choices.expected_effect: Small noise can survive; crop context can include neighbors and can still truncate missing text. Final ten-block cap can discard valid candidates.
